function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a file in the in-memory filesystem. Apps go in apps/<name>.lua.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file from the in-memory filesystem.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List all files with their sizes.

function.name: run_lua
function.description: Run Lua code non-interactively and return what it printed, or the error with a traceback. No keyboard input; 10 second limit.

function.name: launch_app
function.description: Start a saved Lua app on the user's console. The user interacts with it directly; this returns when the app exits, with the error if it crashed.
